intersection.headline: Nike launches the Vegam Run, its first running shoe designed specifically for Indian runners
intersection.summary: The entry-level shoe is priced at ₹3,795. It launches on 1 November through Flipkart and select retailers. It follows Nike's first collaboration with an Indian label last year.

sports.headline: Golden State Valkyries win the WNBA title in their second season
sports.summary: Gabby Williams scored 30 points and was named Finals MVP as the Valkyries beat the Atlanta Dream 68-63 in the first Game 7 in WNBA Finals history. The Valkyries became the fastest expansion team to win a WNBA title. They also won without a single All-WNBA selection that season.

sports.headline: Copa Libertadores final set: Estudiantes v Palmeiras after semi-final penalty shoot-outs
sports.summary: Estudiantes and Palmeiras both progressed on penalties, setting up an Argentina v Brazil final at Estadio Centenario in Montevideo on 28 November. The Copa Sudamericana final is also set, with Boca Juniors against Atlético Mineiro on 21 November in Barranquilla.

fashion.headline: WWD x SKP summit: Pop Mart, Mao Geping, Aranya and LVMH on China's changing fashion consumer
fashion.summary: Chinese founders and LVMH's Greater China president discussed how brands in China now have to offer emotion, culture and a clear sense of what they stand for. Shoppers no longer accept a brand simply for being new, foreign or inexpensive.

fashion.headline: Deion Sanders Jr.'s Well Off Forever to release its first public Nike sneaker
fashion.summary: The Well Off Forever x Nike Air DT Proto 92 is a gold-accented Diamond Turf prototype look. It is expected on 30 November at $180. It is the label's first public Nike release.

marketing.headline: Liquid I.V. names former Poppi CMO Jenny Danzi as chief marketing officer
marketing.summary: Unilever-owned Liquid I.V. has hired Danzi, a former PepsiCo marketer, to lead integrated marketing and creative strategy. She fills the seat vacated by Stacey Andrade-Wells, who left to join Bobbie. Her brief is to combine the brand's clinical positioning with culture-first lifestyle marketing.

marketing.headline: Philadelphia 76ers become the first NBA team to sign a prediction-market partner, with Kalshi
marketing.summary: The 76ers agreed a multi-year deal naming Kalshi their official prediction market partner. It follows the NBA's own league-level Kalshi and Polymarket deals earlier in the week. LeBron James, now at the 76ers, already has a Polymarket partnership.

marketing.headline: Angel City FC hires CrossFit's Jenna Hauca as CMO and Amazon's Ali D'Andrea as chief revenue officer
marketing.summary: The women's football club added two senior commercial leaders, both reporting to CEO Amy Taylor and starting in November. Hauca has been CMO at CrossFit since March 2024. D'Andrea joins from Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios. Reported in Sportico's weekly transactions wire.

marketing.headline: Adweek marketer moves: Coursera's CMO from The New York Times, Beast Industries' first CMO, Diageo North America CMO, Amex CMO to retire
marketing.summary: Adweek rounds up the week's marketing leadership changes. Amy Weisenbach leaves the New York Times for Coursera. MrBeast's Beast Industries promotes its first CMO. Diageo North America hires Sebnem Erim. American Express CMO Elizabeth Rutledge will retire in March 2027.

marketing.headline: Starbucks looks to pivot away from reliance on seasonal marketing
marketing.summary: The global coffee chain, known for its pumpkin spice latte and other seasonal drinks, is looking to build more consistent year-round relevance. Marketing Week reports on the strategy shift.
